jobs.title: Editorial Content Strategist, Digital & Insights
jobs.description:
Who We Are

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

Our Corporate Positioning and Insights (CPI&I) practice seeks a talented, versatile Editorial Content Strategist
with 6+ years of experience to join the team in our New York, Chicago or Washington, D.C. office. We’re looking for a multidisciplinary content strategist who will sit at the intersection of earned media, digital strategy, and creative production. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, has strong instincts for what makes a story land, and can move seamlessly from strategy to execution. You'll work in close partnership with our media relations team, serving as the content engine that creates powerful stories to amplify across channels.

What You'll Do

Lead rapid response content development across earned, owned, and paid channels for large scale campaign — from breaking news moments to proactive campaign beats
Serve as the editorial and strategic lead on content that reaches a variety of audiences, including but not limited to media, policymakers and regulators
Monitor news cycles, track emerging trends, and identify opportunities to insert clients into relevant conversations
Draft and edit a range of content quickly and with precision, including press materials, digital copy, paid media scripts, executive messaging, and more
Develop content strategies for long-term reputation building projects, ensuring consistent narrative continuity across campaigns, channels, and client touchpoints
Partner closely with the media relations team to ensure content is strategically aligned, on message, and ready to move at the pace of the news cycle
Collaborate with digital, creative, and design teams to concept and produce campaign assets aligned to strategic objectives
Partner across practice areas to ensure content is integrated, consistent, and ladders up to broader campaign goals
Bring a journalist's instincts and a strategist's discipline to everything you write and produce
Collaborate with SEO, AEO, and analytics experts to optimize content performance and discoverability.
Stay current on emerging content trends, AI tools, audience behaviors, and platform best practices.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

Basic Qualifications

What You Will Need to Succeed

6+ years of experience in communications, PR, content strategy, or a related field
Deep understanding of the media landscape and what makes content newsworthy — without necessarily owning media relationships directly
Strong writing across formats — long-form, short-form, organic social, paid media, executive voice
Experience translating data and insights into multichannel content
Experience working in or alongside digital and creative teams on integrated campaigns
Comfort with the creative concepting process and ability to brief and collaborate with designers and producers
Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure
Strong project management capabilities, including oversight of multichannel, integrated campaigns, with a proven ability to manage senior and junior team members

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in public affairs, policy, or regulated industries is a plus
Experience working with optimization for SEO and LLMs

FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

Compensation

Minimum Pay: $86,000

Maximum Pay: $141,500

Compensation Disclosure:
The compensation range reflects potential base salary for the role. Actual compensation is determined based on a wide array of relevant factors including market considerations, business needs, and an individual’s location, skills, level of experience, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Design Director - Women’s Swimwear
jobs.description:
Job Title: Design Director - Women’s Swimwear

A high-profile designer brand is seeking a Design Director to lead its women’s swimwear category. This highly visible leadership role will define the creative vision for the collection and translate the brand’s design codes into compelling, commercially relevant product.

Reporting directly to the President, the Design Director will manage two direct reports and collaborate extensively with cross-functional partners and senior leadership. The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative taste, deep swimwear expertise, and the executive presence needed to influence decisions at the highest levels of the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Establish and lead the seasonal creative direction for women’s swimwear.
Develop collections that balance brand identity, innovation, quality, and commercial opportunity.
Guide the design process from initial concept and research through final product execution.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two direct reports.
Partner closely with merchandising, product development, technical design, sourcing, production, and marketing.
Present concepts, seasonal direction, and product recommendations to the President and senior leadership.
Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, consumer behavior, runway trends, materials, color, and emerging swimwear innovation.
Ensure consistency across silhouette, fit, fabrication, print, color, and detailing.
Manage multiple seasonal priorities while maintaining a high standard of creative and operational execution.

Candidate Profile

Significant design leadership experience within women’s swimwear, designer fashion, or a closely related category.
Strong portfolio demonstrating elevated taste, distinctive creative direction, and commercially successful product.
Proven ability to lead a category and guide collections from concept through production.
Experience managing and developing design talent.
Highly collaborative, with a track record of building productive cross-functional relationships.
Exceptional executive function, including strong judgment, organization, communication, and follow-through.
Confident presenting to and influencing presidents, founders, and other senior executives.
Deep knowledge of swimwear construction, fit, fabrication, print, color, and technical requirements.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-visibility designer environment.

Salary $200,000

jobs.title: Account Director
jobs.description:
Company Description

Digitas is the Networked Experience Agency, built on the vision that we create magnetic experiences that earn the right for brands to exist in human networks. Today, and tomorrow. We deliver Networked Experiences by leveraging comprehensive data, technology, creative, media and strategy capabilities. Digitas delivers ambitious outcomes via unique solutions that include Creative Experiences, Integrated Media, Addressable Relationships, Social Marketing and Total Commerce. Celebrated by AdAge as Data and Insights Agency of the Year, U.S Campaign’s Brand Experience Agency of the Year, Media Network of the Year and celebrated by Forrester and Gartner, Digitas serves the world’s leading brands through a global network comprised of more than 5,500 employees across over 65 offices in 43 countries.

The Digitas culture is made up of fearless, inventive and generous Unicorns of all kinds.

Overview

We are seeking a highly strategic Account Director with proven success leading complex, media-driven integrated accounts. The ideal candidate is a visionary leader who inspires clients with their creativity and eloquence, while possessing the tactical chops to expertly guide day-to-day media operations. If you are a big-picture thinker who still loves getting into the details, keep reading.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Media Planning

Lead the development of audience-centric, insight-driven media strategies across HCP, DTC, Payer, and other healthcare audiences.
Oversee the strategic direction, channel architecture, and budget allocation across assigned accounts.
Translate business objectives, market dynamics, customer insights, and performance data into actionable media recommendations.
Guide teams through annual planning, tactical planning, optimization, and measurement processes.
Ensure media strategies align with broader brand, marketing, and business objectives.
Partner with analytics, investment, activation, and client engagement teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Identify opportunities to introduce innovative media approaches, emerging channels, and evolving healthcare marketing trends.
Contribute strategic expertise to new business opportunities, pitches, and agency initiatives.

Client Leadership

Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders.
Serve as a strategic consultant, helping clients navigate complex marketing challenges and opportunities.
Present media recommendations, strategic rationale, and performance insights with confidence and clarity.
Anticipate client needs and proactively provide solutions that support business growth.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of clients' brands, competitive landscape, customer journeys, and market dynamics.
Elevate the quality and strategic rigor of all client-facing deliverables.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, mentor, and develop Strategy team members across assigned accounts.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.
Provide ongoing coaching, performance feedback, and career development support.
Ensure team members are trained on agency processes, planning frameworks, and media tools.
Support onboarding and integration of new hires.
Participate in performance management, goal setting, and talent review processes.
Help recruit, interview, and retain top strategic talent.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Client Engagement, Analytics, Investment, Activation, and Creative teams to deliver integrated client solutions.
Align stakeholders around strategic recommendations and account priorities.
Represent media strategy perspectives in internal and external meetings.
Help establish processes that improve efficiency, quality, and collaboration across teams.
Contribute to agency thought leadership and strategic best practices.

Industry & Technical Expertise

Maintain deep expertise in pharmaceutical marketing, healthcare regulations, and evolving media landscapes.
Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, consumer behaviors, and competitive activity.
Demonstrate expertise across traditional, digital, programmatic, social, search, video, and omnichannel media strategies.
Leverage media research, audience intelligence, measurement, and planning tools to inform recommendations.
Continuously expand knowledge of agency capabilities, products, and healthcare marketing innovations.

Qualifications

Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Proven ability to lead teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated success building relationships with clients, internal partners, and senior stakeholders.
Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills.
Ability to influence decision-making through data, insights, and strategic recommendations.
Collaborative leadership style with a commitment to coaching and team development.
Embodies agency values of Accountability, Collaboration, Empathy, Equanimity, Integrity, and Respect.

Education & Experience

8+ years of media strategy, planning, or integrated marketing experience.
3+ years of people management experience.
Pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences marketing experience required.
Experience developing omnichannel media strategies across HCP and DTC audiences.
Strong understanding of media research, planning, and measurement tools.
Experience managing multiple brands, clients, and cross-functional teams.

Additional Information

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent.

Publicis Groupe provides robust and inclusive benefit programs and policies to support the evolving and diverse needs of our talent and enable every person to grow and thrive. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off.

If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact USMTTACompliance@publicis.com.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Compensation Range: USD $97,375.00 - USD $149,296.00/Annually. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 10/1/2026.

jobs.description:
Please Note: If you are a current Spin Master employee with access to Workday, apply to this job via the Workday application.

Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company?

At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you!

Job Description

What will you work on?

We are seeking a Senior Art Director to lead creative development and execution across hero campaigns, digital content, e-commerce, social media, and photography. Reporting to the Creative Director, this role requires strategic planning aligned with broader brand objectives, big creative thinking, and the ability to work independently.

How will you create impact?

Understand brand positioning and business goals to develop integrated campaigns and activations that support long-term strategy. Lead visual and creative development from concept through execution across digital, print, social media, and video platforms
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including brand marketing, strategists, product design, and leadership to ensure creative work aligns with business objectives and brand standards
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines. Present concepts and strategies to internal stakeholders with clear rationale tied to brand goals
Plan and art direct photo and video shoots, including pre-production planning, on-set direction, and post-production oversight
Work independently while providing mentorship to junior team members.

What are your skills and experience?

Thrives in a fast-paced environment and comfortable managing multiple projects
Skilled at delivering a high volume of creative output
Tapped into cultural trends in design, social media, music, television, film, etc.
Strong written and oral communication skills to effectively work with all stakeholders
Prior experience working with creative ad agencies is preferred.

The anticipated pay range for candidates who will work in New York is $55/hr to $60/hr [Per Hour]. The offered pay to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience within the job, years of experience within the required industry, education, etc. Spin Master Inc. is a multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work only in other states.

This job posting is tied to an open vacancy.

What You Can Expect From Us

Our mission is to Make Life More Fun with a vision to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun.

Growth and Career Opportunities
Flexible Work Hours
Innovation, Collaboration and Fun
Comprehensive Benefits
Other fun Perks!

What’s it like to work here?

Spin Master is a fast-paced, hands-on organization that provides many great opportunities for impactful decision-making; though our challenging start-up atmosphere isn’t for everyone, we have a proven record of opportunities for future advancement and internal transfers for our passionate and results driven team.

Everyone is welcome in our sandbox and we are committed to an accessible and inclusive hiring process that provides reasonable accommodation to all applicants.

Spin Master strives to create an accessible and inclusive application and selection process and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to job applicants who may require provisions to participate in the recruitment, selection and/or assessment processes. Should you require an accommodation, please contact our Talent Acquisition team, by email at TAinquiries@spinmaster.com or by phone at 416 364-6002 and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Follow us on Instagram and Twitter @SpinMaster to stay up to date on Spin Master career opportunities.

We do appreciate all interest; however only those selected for interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Principal Brand Strategist, Amazon Ads, Amazon Ads Marketing
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Ads is one of the fastest-growing businesses at Amazon, helping brands of all sizes connect with customers across our properties and beyond. We're looking for a Principal Brand Strategist to own the development and evolution of the Amazon Ads brand strategy, defining how we show up to advertisers, agencies, and marketing decision-makers worldwide.

This is a high-impact role that will shape the global brand architecture, positioning, and narrative for Amazon Ads across all B2B touchpoints. You will be the strategic backbone behind how Amazon Ads is perceived in the marketplace, driving clarity, consistency, and differentiation in a rapidly evolving advertising landscape.

Key job responsibilities

Brand Architecture & Positioning

Own and evolve the end-to-end brand strategy for Amazon Ads, including brand architecture, positioning, and value propositions across the full portfolio of products and services

Define how Amazon Ads differentiates in the B2B advertising marketplace against competitors

Develop and maintain a scalable brand architecture that accommodates new products and market expansion

Strategic Leadership

Serve as the voice on brand strategy, influencing VP+ leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Translate complex business objectives and product capabilities into compelling, insight-driven brand narratives for B2B audiences (CMOs, media buyers, agency leaders)

Set the long-term brand vision (3–5 year horizon) and build the roadmap to get there

Cross-Functional Influence

Partner with Marketing, Sales, Creative, Events, and PR to ensure brand coherence across all advertiser-facing channels

Align brand strategy with go-to-market motions, sales narratives, and thought leadership programs

Influence global teams to ensure consistent brand expression across markets

Governance & Standards

Establish brand governance frameworks, guidelines, and decision-making criteria for the broader organization

Mentor and elevate brand thinking across the marketing organization

About The Team

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

10+ years' experience in brand strategy, with significant focus on B2B or enterprise marketing

Proven track record of developing and owning brand strategy for a major technology, media, or advertising platform

Experience building brand architecture for complex, multi-product portfolios

Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership (VP+) and drive alignment across large, matrixed organizations

Deep expertise in brand research methodologies, competitive positioning, and B2B buyer journeys

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the advertising/ad-tech industry or marketing to advertisers and agencies

Global brand management experience across multiple markets

Familiarity with Amazon's advertising products and ecosystem

Experience translating technical product capabilities into emotionally resonant brand narratives

Track record of building brand strategy functions or teams from the ground up

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative taste, deep swimwear expertise, and the executive presence needed to influence decisions at the highest levels of the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Establish and lead the seasonal creative direction for women’s swimwear.
Develop collections that balance brand identity, innovation, quality, and commercial opportunity.
Guide the design process from initial concept and research through final product execution.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two direct reports.
Partner closely with merchandising, product development, technical design, sourcing, production, and marketing.
Present concepts, seasonal direction, and product recommendations to the President and senior leadership.
Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, consumer behavior, runway trends, materials, color, and emerging swimwear innovation.
Ensure consistency across silhouette, fit, fabrication, print, color, and detailing.
Manage multiple seasonal priorities while maintaining a high standard of creative and operational execution.

Candidate Profile

Significant design leadership experience within women’s swimwear, designer fashion, or a closely related category.
Strong portfolio demonstrating elevated taste, distinctive creative direction, and commercially successful product.
Proven ability to lead a category and guide collections from concept through production.
Experience managing and developing design talent.
Highly collaborative, with a track record of building productive cross-functional relationships.
Exceptional executive function, including strong judgment, organization, communication, and follow-through.
Confident presenting to and influencing presidents, founders, and other senior executives.
Deep knowledge of swimwear construction, fit, fabrication, print, color, and technical requirements.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-visibility designer environment.

Salary $200,000

Company Description

Digitas is the Networked Experience Agency, built on the vision that we create magnetic experiences that earn the right for brands to exist in human networks. Today, and tomorrow. We deliver Networked Experiences by leveraging comprehensive data, technology, creative, media and strategy capabilities. Digitas delivers ambitious outcomes via unique solutions that include Creative Experiences, Integrated Media, Addressable Relationships, Social Marketing and Total Commerce. Celebrated by AdAge as Data and Insights Agency of the Year, U.S Campaign’s Brand Experience Agency of the Year, Media Network of the Year and celebrated by Forrester and Gartner, Digitas serves the world’s leading brands through a global network comprised of more than 5,500 employees across over 65 offices in 43 countries.

The Digitas culture is made up of fearless, inventive and generous Unicorns of all kinds.

Overview

We are seeking a highly strategic Account Director with proven success leading complex, media-driven integrated accounts. The ideal candidate is a visionary leader who inspires clients with their creativity and eloquence, while possessing the tactical chops to expertly guide day-to-day media operations. If you are a big-picture thinker who still loves getting into the details, keep reading.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Media Planning

Lead the development of audience-centric, insight-driven media strategies across HCP, DTC, Payer, and other healthcare audiences.
Oversee the strategic direction, channel architecture, and budget allocation across assigned accounts.
Translate business objectives, market dynamics, customer insights, and performance data into actionable media recommendations.
Guide teams through annual planning, tactical planning, optimization, and measurement processes.
Ensure media strategies align with broader brand, marketing, and business objectives.
Partner with analytics, investment, activation, and client engagement teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Identify opportunities to introduce innovative media approaches, emerging channels, and evolving healthcare marketing trends.
Contribute strategic expertise to new business opportunities, pitches, and agency initiatives.

Client Leadership

Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders.
Serve as a strategic consultant, helping clients navigate complex marketing challenges and opportunities.
Present media recommendations, strategic rationale, and performance insights with confidence and clarity.
Anticipate client needs and proactively provide solutions that support business growth.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of clients' brands, competitive landscape, customer journeys, and market dynamics.
Elevate the quality and strategic rigor of all client-facing deliverables.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, mentor, and develop Strategy team members across assigned accounts.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.
Provide ongoing coaching, performance feedback, and career development support.
Ensure team members are trained on agency processes, planning frameworks, and media tools.
Support onboarding and integration of new hires.
Participate in performance management, goal setting, and talent review processes.
Help recruit, interview, and retain top strategic talent.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Client Engagement, Analytics, Investment, Activation, and Creative teams to deliver integrated client solutions.
Align stakeholders around strategic recommendations and account priorities.
Represent media strategy perspectives in internal and external meetings.
Help establish processes that improve efficiency, quality, and collaboration across teams.
Contribute to agency thought leadership and strategic best practices.

Industry & Technical Expertise

Maintain deep expertise in pharmaceutical marketing, healthcare regulations, and evolving media landscapes.
Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, consumer behaviors, and competitive activity.
Demonstrate expertise across traditional, digital, programmatic, social, search, video, and omnichannel media strategies.
Leverage media research, audience intelligence, measurement, and planning tools to inform recommendations.
Continuously expand knowledge of agency capabilities, products, and healthcare marketing innovations.

Qualifications

Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Proven ability to lead teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated success building relationships with clients, internal partners, and senior stakeholders.
Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills.
Ability to influence decision-making through data, insights, and strategic recommendations.
Collaborative leadership style with a commitment to coaching and team development.
Embodies agency values of Accountability, Collaboration, Empathy, Equanimity, Integrity, and Respect.

Education & Experience

8+ years of media strategy, planning, or integrated marketing experience.
3+ years of people management experience.
Pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences marketing experience required.
Experience developing omnichannel media strategies across HCP and DTC audiences.
Strong understanding of media research, planning, and measurement tools.
Experience managing multiple brands, clients, and cross-functional teams.

Additional Information

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact USMTTACompliance@publicis.com.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Description

Amazon Ads is one of the fastest-growing businesses at Amazon, helping brands of all sizes connect with customers across our properties and beyond. We're looking for a Principal Brand Strategist to own the development and evolution of the Amazon Ads brand strategy, defining how we show up to advertisers, agencies, and marketing decision-makers worldwide.

This is a high-impact role that will shape the global brand architecture, positioning, and narrative for Amazon Ads across all B2B touchpoints. You will be the strategic backbone behind how Amazon Ads is perceived in the marketplace, driving clarity, consistency, and differentiation in a rapidly evolving advertising landscape.

Key job responsibilities

Brand Architecture & Positioning

Own and evolve the end-to-end brand strategy for Amazon Ads, including brand architecture, positioning, and value propositions across the full portfolio of products and services

Define how Amazon Ads differentiates in the B2B advertising marketplace against competitors

Develop and maintain a scalable brand architecture that accommodates new products and market expansion

Strategic Leadership

Serve as the voice on brand strategy, influencing VP+ leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Translate complex business objectives and product capabilities into compelling, insight-driven brand narratives for B2B audiences (CMOs, media buyers, agency leaders)

Set the long-term brand vision (3–5 year horizon) and build the roadmap to get there

Cross-Functional Influence

Partner with Marketing, Sales, Creative, Events, and PR to ensure brand coherence across all advertiser-facing channels

Align brand strategy with go-to-market motions, sales narratives, and thought leadership programs

Influence global teams to ensure consistent brand expression across markets

Governance & Standards

Establish brand governance frameworks, guidelines, and decision-making criteria for the broader organization

Mentor and elevate brand thinking across the marketing organization

About The Team

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

10+ years' experience in brand strategy, with significant focus on B2B or enterprise marketing

Proven track record of developing and owning brand strategy for a major technology, media, or advertising platform

Experience building brand architecture for complex, multi-product portfolios

Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership (VP+) and drive alignment across large, matrixed organizations

Deep expertise in brand research methodologies, competitive positioning, and B2B buyer journeys

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the advertising/ad-tech industry or marketing to advertisers and agencies

Global brand management experience across multiple markets

Familiarity with Amazon's advertising products and ecosystem

Experience translating technical product capabilities into emotionally resonant brand narratives

Track record of building brand strategy functions or teams from the ground up
